introduction.text_001: Every program gets its own quote.
introduction.text_004: Every feature on this site, turned on or off to fit your program.
introduction.text_005: Parent and student portals at no cost to families.
introduction.text_006: Guided setup, and support from someone who has run a program.
introduction.text_007: No payment fees. Families pay through your own processor account, and Program Partner never takes a percentage.

setup_and_purchasing.text_009: Guided setup is included. If you want us to move your records in, send us your spreadsheets and we'll import your students, families, inventory and music library. Importing is quoted to your data, because a clean 50-row roster and a 15-year-old instrument spreadsheet are different jobs.
setup_and_purchasing.text_011: Need a quote for your bookkeeper, a W-9 or a vendor form? Ask and we'll send it.
setup_and_purchasing.text_013: Programs vary too much for one price to be fair. A quote takes one business day.
setup_and_purchasing.text_014: Do families pay anything to use it?
setup_and_purchasing.text_015: No. Families only pay the fees your program assigns.
